name: de.plateaucandy/plateau-candy
description: Cologne design studio as MCP tools: profile, services, availability, consultation booking.

tools.name: get_profile
tools.description: Get studio profile — what Plateau Candy does, expertise, team, and contact. Use this first to understand who Plateau Candy is; returns identity, expertise areas, clients and all contact channels.

tools.name: get_services
tools.description: Get available consultation services from Plateau Candy. Returns event type IDs, titles and durations — call this before get_availability or book_consultation to obtain the required event_type_id.

tools.name: get_availability
tools.description: Check available time slots for a consultation with Plateau Candy. Requires an event_type_id from get_services; returns bookable slots per day in Europe/Berlin time.

event_type_id.description: Event type ID (get from get_services first)

end_date.description: End date (YYYY-MM-DD), max 14 days from start

tools.name: book_consultation
tools.description: Book a consultation with Plateau Candy. Requires a specific time slot from get_availability. Notes required (min 10 chars). Booking requires manual confirmation.

tools.name: get_capabilities
tools.description: Get detailed capabilities, problem types addressed, and what Plateau Candy does NOT do. Use this to judge project fit: lists services, explicit non-services, and typical budget/duration ranges.
